## Problem and behavior

What changes for the user or contributor? Link the existing design/tracker when applicable.

## Decisions and scope

Explain consequential choices, assumptions and intentionally excluded work.

## Verification

List actual commands/manual scenarios and outcomes. Distinguish static, fixture, native runtime, live-provider and stress evidence; state what was not run and why.

## Remaining work

Link deferred checks or open decisions in their canonical owners. Include screenshots for relevant visual changes; never attach secrets, private saves or unlicensed assets.
